integrity: Finite enumerations were executed independently of the closed-form transfer-matrix proof. The scientific assessment is self-review only; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The structural recovery result is restricted to crowns with one added comparability, and the collision theorem to the stated two-comparability families. It does not imply global one-type reconstruction. The full scanned text of a relevant garland-enumeration paper was inaccessible, leaving possible implicit prior coverage.
title: A sharp one-versus-two chord transition in generic-poset one-type counts
